Quota for 2026 Fall semester: 1
Every student can choose one-semester or one-academic-year exchange.
But the total quota is one.

Program A
Program A is to offer courses in English. In the program, undergraduate students take courses in Japanese language, Japanese affairs, and specialized courses in English; whereas graduate students receive research instructions in English. Those who meet the language requirement of both Program A and B may apply for Program A so that they can take courses both in English and Japanese.
To apply for Program A, applicants must have TOEFL PBT or ITP 500 / TOEFL iBT 61, or its equivalent.

Program B
Program B is for exchange students who have high Japanese language proficiency to take regular courses in Japanese and study with University of Fukui students. Undergraduate students take common education courses as well as specialized courses offered by the School of Education, School of Engineering, and/or School of Global and Community Studies. Graduate students take specialized courses offered by the Graduate School of Education and/or Graduate School of Engineering. Graduate students can also enroll in the university as Research Students and conduct research without taking courses.
To apply for Program B,  applicants must have a Japanese proficiency which is equal to or higher than a N2 level on the Japanese Language Proficiency Test.

SAXON STUDENT MOBILITY PROGRAM (SSMP)
The scholarship“Saxon Students Mobility Program” for incoming exchange students (the call for applications is attached), funded by the Saxon State Ministry for Science, Culture and Tourism.
The funding program offers students from Taiwan the opportunity to study (exchange semester) at a university in the State of Saxony, Germany.

ACCOMMODATION
The “Studentenwerk Dresden” offers a wide range of affordable accommodations for students.
They can register directly with the Studentenwerk using the online application procedure.
To apply, they will need a copy of the admission letter from HTW Dresden.
We recommend that students apply for a room in a hall of residence as soon as possible after receiving the admission letter, as these are booked out very quickly.

Further accommodation options can be found on our website: https://www.htw-dresden.de/en/international/coming-to-htwd/exchange-programmes

AVAILABLE MODULES
Exchange students can find detailed information on course selection as well as an overview of modules offered in English on the following website:
https://www.htw-dresden.de/en/international/coming-to-htw-dresden/exchange-programmes/modules-in-english

In addition, business students can find all courses taught in English on the website of the Faculty of Business Administration. 

PRACTICAL INFORMATION
Looking for more info or need help with practical issues?
The answers can be found on our website “Exchange programmes”.

SEMESTER CONTRIBUTION
There are no tuition fees at HTW Dresden, but there is a mandatory semester contribution (approx. 360 EUR). The semester contribution includes contributions to the student union, the student council and the “German semester ticket” which allows students to travel throughout Germany on public transportation (local trains, suburban trains, subways, buses, trams, and many ferries).

SEMESTER DATES – WINTER SEMESTER 2026/27

Lecture period: 05 October 2026 until 30 January 2027
Examination period: 01 February 2027 until 20 February 2027

Undergraduate Exchange Admission Requirements
Exchange Undergraduate Admission Requirement Checklist

Academic Requirements
A minimum CGPA of 2.5 on a 4.0 scale (or equivalent) in an accredited international post secondary institution (college/university). Transcripts must be from the exchange institution.

English Language Requirement
In order to begin academic programs at Pittsburg State University, all International students must submit an official, passing TOEFL, IELTS or PTE score to the Office of International Programs and Services.

TOEFL
TOEFL score of at least 520 (paper) or 68 (internet) is required. In addition, a minimum score of 15 is required in each section (internet). Some academic programs (majors) may require a higher TOEFL score.* Institutional TOEFL and ITP TOEFL scores are not accepted.

IELTS
Overall score of 6.0 with a minimum score of 5.0 in each band of the IELTS is required. If a lower score is earned in any of the five band scores, the overall score cannot be accepted. Some academic programs (majors) may require a higher IELTS score.

PTE
Overall score of 47. Some academic programs (majors) may require a higher PTE score.
